environment-not-browser.detail: This check only runs meaningfully in the browser.

insecure-context.detail: Web MIDI access needs HTTPS on hosted environments.

api-unavailable.detail: The current browser does not expose navigator.requestMIDIAccess.

available.detail: This browser can request MIDI access and enumerate compatible devices.

error.security: The browser blocked MIDI access for security reasons.
error.aborted: The MIDI access request was interrupted.
error.invalid-state: The MIDI access request could not be completed in the current state.
error.unsupported: The browser does not support this MIDI request.
